en.ms: M:- Because of worldly love, the mortal thinks of death and God, the lover of Nectar, only, when he is about die.
en.ssk: Mamma: In emotional attachment, he dies; he only thinks of the Lord, the Love of Nectar, when he dies.

ss.unicode: ਹੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ! ਤੇਰੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਮੱਥੇ ਉਤੇ ਜੋ (ਮਾਇਆ ਵਾਲਾ) ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ, ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਉਸ ਲੇਖ ਨੂੰ ਪੜ੍ਹ (ਭਾਵ, ਪਿਛਲੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਜੋ ਸੰਸਕਾਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਹੋਏ ਪਏ ਹਨ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰ ਉਮਰ ਗੁਜ਼ਾਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈਂ, ਪਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸਮਝਦਾ ਤੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਅਖਵਾਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ । ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦਾ ਇਹ ਕਰਤੱਬ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਿ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੀ ਰਤਾ ਭੀ ਸੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਵੇ । ਨਿਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰ ਦੌੜ-ਭੱਜ ਛੱਡ, ਤੇ) ਹੋਰਨਾਂ (ਚਾਟੜਿਆਂ) ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਨਿਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾ ਲੇਖਾ-ਪਤ੍ਰਾ ਨਾਹ ਸਿਖਾਲ ।

en.bdb: The daughter of the alms-giver is just like your own; by accepting this payment for performing the wedding ceremony, you have cursed your own life. ||6||

en.ssk: The daughter of the alms-giver is just like your own; by accepting this payment for performing the wedding ceremony, you have cursed your own life. ||6||

es.sn: porque su hija es como la tuya. Recibiendo salario por conducir su matrimonio, tu vida es maldecida. (6)

transliteration.ur: ساای پُتریِ ججمان کیِ سا تےریِ اےت دھان کھادھَے تےرا جنم گایا ۔۔۶۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: mMmY miq ihir leI qyrI mUVy haumY vfw rogu pieAw ]
verse.unicode: ਮੰਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਪਇਆ ॥

en.bdb: Mamma: You have been cheated out your intellect, you fool, and you are afflicted with the great disease of ego.
en.ms: M:-- Thou hast been denuded of thy intellect, O fool, and art infested with the great malady of self-conceit.
en.ssk: Mamma: You have been cheated out your intellect, you fool, and you are afflicted with the great disease of ego.

ss.unicode: ਹੇ ਮੂਰਖ! (ਇਕ ਪਾਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਲਾਲਚ ਨੇ) ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਲ ਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ (ਤੈਨੂੰ ‘ਕੁਥਾਇ ਦਾਨ’ ਲੈਣ ਤੋਂ ਭੀ ਸੰਕੋਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ । ਦੂਜੇ ਪਾਸੇ) ਤੈਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਵੱਡਾ (ਆਤਮਕ) ਰੋਗ ਚੰਬੜਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ (ਵਿਦਵਾਨ) ਹਾਂ, ਮੈਂ (ਵਿਦਵਾਨ) ਹਾਂ ।

ft.gurmukhi: mMmY AKr ny eyh khw hY: hy mUrK! qyrI buD haumY ny (ihir leI) curw leI hY[ ieh hMkwr hI quJy bfw rog hoqw BÎw hY ArQwq AswD rog BÎw hY]

ms.gurmukhi: m-qyrI Akl mwrI geI hY hy mUrK! qYƒ svY hMgqw dI BwrI ibmwrI icMbV geI hY[
ms.unicode: ਮ-ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਲ ਮਾਰੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ ਹੇ ਮੂਰਖ! ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸਵੈ ਹੰਗਤਾ ਦੀ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਬੜ ਗਈ ਹੈ।

es.sn: Mamma: Tu intelecto ha sido engañado, y estás infestado de ego.

transliteration.english: ma(n)mai mat hir liee teree mooRe haumai vaddaa rog piaa ||
transliteration.hindi: मंमै मति हिरि लई तेरी मूड़े हउमै वडा रोगु पइआ ॥

verse.gurmukhi: AMqr AwqmY bRhmu n cIin@Aw mwieAw kw muhqwju BieAw ]7]
verse.unicode: ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੭॥

en.bdb: Within your innermost self, you do not recognize God, and you compromise yourself for the sake of Maya. ||7||
en.ms: Within thy mind, thou seest not the Lord and demeanest thyself for wealth.
en.ssk: Within your innermost self, you do not recognize God, and you compromise yourself for the sake of Maya. ||7||

ms.unicode: ਆਪਣੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਧਨ ਦੌਲਤ ਦੀ ਖਾਤਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਬੇਇਜਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।

es.sn: No concibes a tu Señor en tu ser interior y te apoyas en Maya. (7)

transliteration.english: a(n)tar aatamai braham na cheeni(h)aa maiaa kaa muhataaj bhiaa ||7||
transliteration.hindi: अंतर आतमै ब्रहमु न चीनि्िआ माइआ का मुहताजु भइआ ॥७॥
transliteration.en: a(n)tar aatamai braham na cheeni(h)aa maiaa kaa muhataaj bhiaa ||7||
transliteration.hi: अंतर आतमै ब्रहमु न चीनि्िआ माइआ का मुहताजु भइआ ॥७॥
transliteration.ipa: əŋt̪ər əɑt̪əmæ bɹəhəm nə t͡ʃinɪ@əɑ mɑɪɑ kɑ mʊhət̪ɑd͡ʒ ɓɪɑ.7.
transliteration.ur: اںتر آتمَے برهم ن چیٍنھآ ماایا کا مُهتاج بھایا ۔۔۷۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: kkY kwim k®oiD BrimEhu mUVy mmqw lwgy quDu hir ivsirAw ]
verse.unicode: ਕਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਭਰਮਿਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ॥

en.bdb: Kakka: You wander around in sexual desire and anger, you fool; attached to possessiveness, you have forgotten the Lord.
en.ms: K:-- In lust and wrath, thou wanderest, O fool. Attached to worldly love, thou hast forgotten God.
en.ssk: Kakka: You wander around in sexual desire and anger, you fool; attached to possessiveness, you have forgotten the Lord.

es.sn: Kakka: Eres desviado por la lujuria, el enojo y el apego, y así abandonas a tu Señor.

transliteration.hindi: ककै कामि क्रोधि भरमिओहु मूड़े ममता लागे तुधु हरि विसरिआ ॥
transliteration.en: kakai kaam karodh bharamioh mooRe mamataa laage tudh har visariaa ||

transliteration.ipa: kəkæ kɑm kəʳɔt̪ə̀ ɓərəmɪoəh muɽe məmət̪ɑ lɑGe t̪ʊt̪ hər ʋɪsərɪəɑ.
transliteration.ur: ککَے کام ک®ودھ بھرماوهُ مُوڑے ممتا لاگے تُدھ هر وسرآ ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: pVih guxih qUM bhuqu pukwrih ivxu bUJy qUM fUib muAw ]8]
verse.unicode: ਪੜਹਿ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤੂੰ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਆ ॥੮॥

en.bdb: You read, and reflect, and proclaim out loud, but without understanding, you are drowned to death. ||8||
en.ms: Thou readest reflectest and proclaimest much, but without knowing, thou art drowned to death.
en.ssk: You read, and reflect, and proclaim out loud, but without understanding, you are drowned to death. ||8||

verse.unicode: ਭਭੈ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੁਬੋਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਲਤਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥

en.bdb: Bhabha: You have drowned in the terrifying world-ocean, you fool, and you have become engrossed in Maya.
en.ms: Bh:-- O fool, thou art drowned in the terrible world ocean, and art engrossed in the worldly valuables.
en.ssk: Bhabha: You have drowned in the terrifying world-ocean, you fool, and you have become engrossed in Maya.

es.sn: Bhabbha: Oh tonto, fuiste ahogado en el mar de las existencias materiales y te involucraste en la Maya.

en.ssk: One who comes to know the One Lord, by Guru's Grace, is carried across in an instant. ||11||

en.ssk: This opportunity shall not come again, you fool; you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||12||

en.bdb: Jhajha: You shall never have to regret and repent, you fool, if you listen to the Teachings of the True Guru, for even an instant.
en.ms: Jh:-- Thou shalt never repent, O fool, if thou hearest the True Guru's instruction even a little.
en.ssk: Jhajha: You shall never have to regret and repent, you fool, if you listen to the Teachings of the True Guru, for even an instant.

en.bdb: Without the True Guru, there is no Guru at all; one who is without a Guru has a bad reputation. ||13||
en.ms: Without the True Guru, there is not another Guru, and the one without the Guru has a bad name.
en.ssk: Without the True Guru, there is no Guru at all; one who is without a Guru has a bad reputation. ||13||

en.ms: Dh:-- Restrain thy wandering mind O foolish man. within thee is the Name treasure.
en.ssk: Dhadha: Restrain your wandering mind, you fool; deep within you the treasure is to be found.

en.bdb: When one becomes Gurmukh, then he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; throughout the ages, he continues to drink it in. ||14||
en.ms: If man becomes a Guru-ward, then does he drink God's elixir, and continues he, to quaff if, all the ages through.
en.ssk: When one becomes Gurmukh, then he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; throughout the ages, he continues to drink it in. ||14||

en.ssk: Gagga: Keep the Lord of the Universe in your mind, you fool; by mere words, no one has ever attained Him.

es.sn: Gagga: Enaltece a tu Señor en tu mente, oh tonto; con sólo hablar, Él no es obtenido.

en.bdb: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart, you fool, and all your past sins shall be forgiven. ||15||
en.ms: Guru's feet abide thou in thy mind, O stupid person. All thine past sins, he shall forgive.
en.ssk: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart, you fool, and all your past sins shall be forgiven. ||15||

es.sn: Enaltece los Pies del Señor en tu corazón para que tus errores pasados sean borrados. (15)

en.bdb: Haha: Understand the Lord's Sermon, you fool; only then shall you attain eternal peace.
en.ms: H:-- God's discourse understand thou, O fool, then alone shalt thou attain eternal peace.
en.ssk: Haha: Understand the Lord's Sermon, you fool; only then shall you attain eternal peace.

verse.unicode: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੬॥

en.bdb: The more the self-willed manmukhs read, the more pain they suffer. Without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||16||
en.ms: The more the perverse read, more the anguish they suffer. Without the True Guru there is no salvation.
en.ssk: The more the self-willed manmukhs read, the more pain they suffer. Without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||16||

en.ssk: Rarra: Center your consciousness on the Lord, you fool; abide with those whose hearts are filled with the Lord.

en.ms: Seeing the Lord's vision my heart-burning is stopped and the fraud of mammon is ended
en.ssk: My burning desires were quenched, when I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the fraudulent illusion of Maya is gone.

en.ms: Meeting with my God, face to face, all my desires are fulfilled and I serve His feet like a bond-slave.
en.ssk: All my desires have been fulfilled, meeting the Lord face-to-face; I am His servant, I serve at His feet.

en.ms: Death's courier can spy not those, who long for the love and service of the world-Lord.
en.ssk: I long for loving devotion to the Lord of the Universe, and so the Messenger of Death cannot even see me.

en.ms: Supplicates Nanak, she, whom the Lord has united with Himself; she suffers not separation of love from her Beloved.
en.ssk: Prays Nanak, God has united me with Himself; I shall never suffer separation from my Beloved again. ||6||

en.ms: O my mates and companions, sing ye the songs of rejoicing, God, my Groom, has entered into my home.

en.ssk: They destroy the pains of coming and going. They bring loving devotion to the Lord.

en.bdb: Imbued with the Lord's Love, one is intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise, and does not forget the Lord from his mind, even for an instant.
en.ms: Inebriated with Divine knowledge, one is imbued with God's love, and within his mind forgets not the Lord, even for an instant.
en.ssk: Imbued with the Lord's Love, one is intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise, and does not forget the Lord from his mind, even for an instant.

en.ssk: The angels, the seers and the silent sages search for the Ocean of peace, the Sustainer of the world.

en.ssk: They are imbued with the Lord's essence; united with Him; they are absorbed in devotional worship of the Lord God.

es.sn: Narad canta Su Alabanza, también otros sabios, Vyasa, el autor de los Vedas y Shukdev, su hijo también.

en.ms: By seeking the shelter of the Merciful Master, temporal attachment, ego and doubt are effaced.
en.ssk: Emotional attachment, pride and doubt are eliminated, when one takes to the Sanctuary of the Merciful Lord.

es.sn: Los Gurmukjs están embriagados con la Esencia del Señor y el Señor llena su ser excedidamente.

en.ms: The mortal acquires father's caste only when if the Guru being pleased shown favour unto him.
en.ssk: The father's status is obtained only if the Guru is pleased and bestows His Favor.

en.ms: Finding the Guru with great good fortune, day and night, the man comes to embrace love for the Lord.
en.ssk: By great good fortune, the Guru is found; embrace love for the Lord, day and night.

en.ms: Slave Nanak has realised the pervading Lord and he does the deed of singing God's praises.
en.ssk: Servant Nanak has realized God; he sings the Lord's Praises through the actions he does. ||2||

en.ms: Birth are the faces of the Guru-wards at God's Court. They come to the lord and blend with Him.
en.ssk: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant in the Court of the Lord; they come to the Lord and merge with Him.

es.sn: Radiante está su semblante cuando se encuentra con su Señor, el Dios.

en.bdb: O servant Nanak, they alone find the Guru, with whom the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is pleased. ||6||
en.ms: They obtain the Guru, O servant Nanak! with whom the Lord, the Treasure of excellences, is Himself mightily pleased.
en.ssk: O servant Nanak, they alone find the Guru, with whom the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is pleased. ||6||

en.ms: With every breath and morsel of food, O man! do thou reflect on God.
en.ssk: Meditate on the Lord, with every breath and morsel of food.

en.bdb: The Gurmukhs embrace the Love of the Lord in their minds; they are continually occupied with the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||1||
en.ms: The pious persons, whose way of life is the meditation of God's Name, come to embrace in their mind the love for the Lord. Pause.3

ms.unicode: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਪਵਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਰਸ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਰਹੁ ਰੀਤੀ ਹਰੀ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਹੈ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਚਿੱਤ ਅੰਦਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾ ਪਿਆਰ ਪੈ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਠਹਿਰਾਉ।

es.sn: Mi mente está enamorada de aquéllos que, como rutina diaria, meditan en el Nombre del Señor.  (1-Pausa-1)
